title: [Quality Management] Add OptimizeForTextSearch to searchable Qlty. Inspection Header fields (AB#620381)
summary: Two searchable fields in Quality Management's Inspection Header table now use optimized text search to improve performance on large datasets.
key_points: Added OptimizeForTextSearch property to Description and Source Task No. fields
Enables optimized SQL search path instead of unindexed LIKE scans
Aligns Source Task No. with sibling source-identity fields
Metadata-only change with no behavior or data impact
